programme.title: Eagle Eye
programme.desc: Jerry Shaw (Shia LaBeouf) and Rachel Holloman (Michelle Monaghan) are two strangers whose lives are suddenly thrown into turmoil by a mysterious woman they have never met. Threatening their lives and family, the unseen caller uses everyday technology to control their actions and push them into increasing danger. As events escalate, Jerry and Rachel become the country's most-wanted fugitives and must figure out what is happening to them.

programme.title: Collateral
programme.desc: A cab driver realizes his current fare is a hit man that has been having him drive around from mark to mark until the last witness to a crime is dead. When the cabbie finally figures out the truth, he must prevent the assassin from wiping out his last witness without becoming the next in the professional killer's line of casualties.

programme.title: Paycheck
programme.desc: Michael Jennings is a top-notch reverse engineer. Corporations pay him to crack the secrets of their competitors' products. When the job is done, he has his memory of it erased. Rethrick, head of a company called Allcom, hires Jennings to reverse-engineer a secret government device. After the job, Jennings wakes from the memory erasure to find himself being chased by various agencies. He soon realizes that the fate of the entire world may be in his hands.

programme.title: An Unfinished Life
programme.desc: Einar (Robert Redford), a recovering alcoholic rancher who lives with his loyal pal Mitch (Morgan Freeman), gets an unexpected visit from his daughter-in-law, Jean (Jennifer Lopez), and granddaughter, Griff (Becca Gardner). Einar holds a grudge against Jean because he feels she's responsible for his son's accidental death, but he reluctantly lets her stay at the farm when he learns that she's trapped in a violent relationship. Over time, they grow closer and try to heal their emotional wounds.

programme.title: Bram Stoker's Dracula
programme.desc: An undead Count falls in love with a woman, a dead ringer for his true love who perished centuries earlier.

programme.title: Swept From The Sea
programme.desc: A romance between a servant girl and a shipwreck survivor inflames passions and hatreds in a village.

programme.title: Swept Away
programme.desc: A spoiled socialite is marooned on a deserted island with a sailor who cannot stand her.

programme.title: Miracle On The Mountain: The Kincaid Family Story
programme.desc: A dysfunctional family must pull together to survive a plane crash in the wilderness.

programme.title: Cat Ballou
programme.desc: When hired gun Tim Strawn (Lee Marvin) kills her rancher father, Cat Ballou (Jane Fonda) becomes an outlaw set on vengeance. Enlisting the help of washed-up gunslinger Kid Shelleen (also Marvin) as well as the handsome bandit Clay Boone (Michael Callan), Cat strikes back at the land-development company that employed Strawn, and eventually targets the assassin himself. Adding to the lively comedic mood of the film are narrative song performances by Nat King Cole and Stubby Kaye.

programme.title: Born Yesterday
programme.desc: Brassy blonde moll Billie Dawn (Judy Holliday) hits Washington, D.C., with her unscrupulous millionaire sugar daddy, Harry Brock (Broderick Crawford), and his sleazy lawyer, Jim Devery (Howard St. John), who has been pressuring Harry to marry Billie by pointing out that a wife cannot be forced to testify against her husband. In an effort to make Billie more socially acceptable, Harry hires journalist Paul Verrall (William Holden) to smarten her up -- and sparks soon fly between the pair.

programme.title: Diamond Head
programme.desc: The head (Charlton Heston) of a Hawaiian pineapple dynasty refuses to let his sister (Yvette Mimieux) marry a native.

programme.title: Tight Spot
programme.desc: Model Sherry Conley (Ginger Rogers) is offered a chance to get out of jail in return for testifying against mobster Benjamin Costain (Lorne Greene). She is taken to a hotel room to hide until it is time for her testimony, and a romance begins to blossom between the superficially hard-boiled Sherry and police officer Vince Striker (Brian Keith). With time before the trial running out, Costain will stop at nothing to kill her before she can reach the witness stand.

programme.title: Evolution
programme.desc: A firefighting cadet, two college professors, and a geeky-but-sexy government scientist work against an alien organism that has been rapidly evolving ever since its arrival on Earth inside a meteor.

programme.title: Zoolander
programme.desc: Three-time male model of the year, Derek Zoolander, is devastated when he loses the title to newbie Hansel. After the news, Mugatu's fashion empire brainwashes Derek into being an assassin.

programme.title: Anchorman: The Legend of Ron Burgundy
programme.desc: Enter the world of 1970s TV news, where Ron Burgundy and his loyal Channel 4 News Team are San Diego's #1-rated news source. All is well in their male-dominated world of news until rising star reporter Veronica Corningstone turns it upside down.

programme.title: Galaxy Quest
programme.desc: Nearly 20 years after the cult TV show Galaxy Quest was canceled, the cast is asked for help by an alien species to save the universe.

programme.title: Darkman
programme.desc: When thugs employed by a crime boss lead a vicious assault on Dr. Peyton Wilder, leaving him literally and psychologically scarred, an emergency procedure allows him to survive. Upon his recovery, Wilder can find solace only by returning to his scientific work developing synthetic skin, and seeking revenge against the crime boss. He assumes a phantom avenger persona called Darkman, who, with malleable facial qualities, is able to infiltrate and sow terror in the criminal community.

programme.title: The Thing
programme.desc: In remote Antarctica, a group of American research scientists are disturbed at their base camp by a helicopter shooting at a sled dog. When they take in the dog, it brutally attacks both human beings and canines in the camp, and they discover that the beast can assume the shape of its victims. A resourceful helicopter pilot and the camp doctor lead the camp crew in a desperate, gory battle against the vicious creature before it picks them all off, one by one.

programme.title: Firestarter
programme.desc: As youths, Andy McGee and his future wife, Vicky, participated in secret experiments, allowing themselves to be subjected to mysterious medical tests. Years later, the couple's daughter, Charlie, begins to exhibit the ability of setting fires solely with her mind. programme.title: Gilberto Gil
programme.desc: Brazilian artist Gilberto Gil returns to Jazz à Vienne in France with a new round of singing that is inspired by his latest album ‘Fé na Festa': a mixture of celebration, tradition and even some rock now and then. Gilberto Gil, worldwide known for as musician and the Brazilian minister of Culture, was one of the pioneers of the cultural movement ‘tropicalismo'. This movement, with a strong character of social protest, combines elements of traditional Brazilian culture with modern art forms. Gilberto Gil's new sound clearly has its roots in Brazilian culture, yet it is always inspired by jazz.

programme.title: Paul Desmond
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Chucho Valdés
programme.desc: Legendary Cuban pianist Chucho Valdés brought his band ‘Jazz Batá 2' to the Malta Jazz Festival on July 19, 2019. The air was thick with anticipation as Valdés took to the stage, revisiting the small-group concept of his mythical 1972 Cuban album ‘Jazz Batá'. The batá repertoire – the deep classical music of West Africa – permeates Valdés' piano solos throughout the concert. Valdés's band consists of Dreiser Durruthy (Batas and vocals), Yaroldy Abreu (percussions and vocals), Abraham Mansfarroll (percussion), Ramón Vazquez Martirena-Bajo (bass guitar). They delivered a performance that reverberated through the historic island.

programme.title: Ray Charles & The Raelettes
programme.sub-title: Ray Charles and the Raelettes - North Sea Jazz
programme.desc: The North Sea Jazz Festival is the largest indoor music festival in the world, known globally as the event where the past, present and future of jazz are featured within three days. Next to a firm base of jazz as the festival's staple music genre, many others, such as blues, soul, funk, or hip hop, pass by. In 1980, American soul legend Ray Charles brought the Raelettes and the Ray Charles Orchestra to the North Sea Jazz Festival in The Hague. With the full force of these two groups behind him, Charles showed why throughout his storied career he has been viewed as one of the most recognizable voices in music.

programme.title: Elizabeth Shepherd
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Roy Ayers
programme.desc: ‘The legend of the groove' is a series of documentaries devoted to the musicians who were most influential on contemporary hip hop, soul, rhythm 'n' blues, and on the course of history. Between the late 1950s and now, these musicians radically changed music. Although sometimes hardly in the public eye, they have all been major sources of inspiration for today's major artists: Prince, Erykah Badu, Janis Joplin and Jimi Hendrix.

programme.title: Christian McBride
programme.desc: On July 20, 2018, double bassist Christian McBride presented his band ‘New Jawn' at the Malta Jazz Festival. A five-time Grammy winner, McBride is one of the most requested, most recorded, and most respected figures in the music world today. Hailing from Philadelphia, this music luminary combines jazz, R&B, pop/rock, hip hop/neo-soul, and classical. Gracing the Malta Jazz stage with him are Nasheet Waits (drums), Marcus Strickland (tenor sax), and Josh Evans (trumpet).

programme.title: Keith Jarrett
programme.desc: Lugano Estival Jazz is an annual open-air music festival that takes place over five days at the picturesque city of Lugano, Switzerland. Since 1979, this musical Mecca has been a must-attend event for all jazz and world music fans worldwide. On July 3, 1986, American pianist and composer Keith Jarrett is joined by bassist Gary Peacock and drummer Jack DeJohnette at Estival Jazz Lugano. Known as the Standards Trio, they put on an enthralling performance that shows these master musicians at their best.

programme.title: Christian McBride
programme.sub-title: Josh Evans - Ballad Of Ernie Washington
programme.desc: On July 20, 2018, double bassist Christian McBride presented his band ‘New Jawn' at the Malta Jazz Festival. A five-time Grammy winner, McBride is one of the most requested, most recorded, and most respected figures in the music world today. Hailing from Philadelphia, this music luminary combines jazz, R&B, pop/rock, hip hop/neo-soul, and classical. Gracing the Malta Jazz stage with him are Nasheet Waits (drums), Marcus Strickland (tenor sax), and Josh Evans (trumpet).

programme.title: Billie Holiday
programme.desc: “God Bless The Child”, “Foolin' Myself”, and “I Loves You, Porgy”: timeless songs that were made classics by the inimitable Billie Holiday. ‘Lady Day', as her loyal friend and musical partner Lester Young nicknamed her, was a highly original jazz and pop singer. In a career that spanned most of the 1930s, 1940s and 1950s, she displayed an uncanny ability to convey emotion through her voice. Her vocals, which were strongly inspired by instrumental jazz, are admired for their deeply personal and intimate sound. This compilation features recordings from the 1950s of Billie Holiday singing a string of her greatest successes. Enjoy this unique footage of one of jazz's all-time greats!

programme.title: Coleman Hawkins
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Coleman Hawkins
programme.desc: A jazz festival named after the inventor of the instrument most associated with the genre, Adolphe Sax, would be incomplete without the man who laid the groundwork for how the instrument is played today. This must have been the reasoning of the organizers of the Festival International de Jazz Adolphe Sax in Dinant, Belgium, when they invited tenor saxophone giant Coleman Hawkins to perform there in June 1962. Appearing with a group that includes the French pianist George Arvanitas, one-time Duke Ellington bassist Jimmy Woode, and expat drummer Kansas Fields, the musician also known as ‘Bean' and ‘Hawk' serves up an hour-long set of familiar standards bookended by Hank Jones' “Chant” and J. J. Johnson's “Wee Dot”.

programme.title: Frans Welser-Möst, Cleveland Orchestra and Chorus, Siobhan Stagg & Avery Amereau
programme.desc: Franz Welser-Möst conducts the Cleveland Orchestra and Chorus in a concert performing Richard Strauss' Metamorphosen (A Study for 23 Solo Strings) and Mozart's Requiem, K. 626. Soloists are Siobhan Stagg (soprano), Avery Amereau (contralto), Ben Bliss (tenor) and Anthony Robin Schneider (bass). Recorded at Severance Hall, Cleveland in March 2023.

programme.title: Jos van Immerseel, Anima Eterna Brugge, Claron McFadden & Bart Van Caenegem
programme.desc: Belgian conductor Jos van Immerseel leads Anima Eterna Brugge in a concert program dedicated to American composer George Gershwin. The program opens with Gershwin's symphonic suite Catfish Row (arr. Steven D. Bowen) which is based upon music from his famous opera Porgy and Bess (1935). This is followed by the well-known tone poem An American in Paris (1928). After, soprano Claron McFadden joins the orchestra, presenting a selection of Gershwin's classic jazz songs, including ‘The man I love' (1924-27), ‘I got rhythm' (1930), and ‘By Strauss' (1936). She also performs ‘My man's gone now' and ‘Summertime' from Porgy and Bess. The concert ends with Gershwin's celebrated Rhapsody in Blue, with Bart Van Caenegem as featured pianist. This performance was recorded at Concertgebouw Brugge, Belgium, on March 3, 2017.

programme.title: Sir Simon Rattle & London Symphony Orchestra
programme.sub-title: Beethoven - Symphony No. 5 in C minor, Op. 67
programme.desc: Sir Simon Rattle conducts the London Symphony Orchestra (LSO) in a performance of Ludwig van Beethoven's well-known Symphony No. 5 in C minor, Op. 67. With Sir Simon Rattle's mischievous enthusiasm, this famous heavyweight symphony sounds new again. This performance was recorded at LSO St. Luke's in London, UK, on September 23, 2020.

programme.title: Roberto Abbado, Filarmonica Arturo Toscanini, Coro del Teatro Regio di Parma & Eleonora Buratto
programme.desc: Roberto Abbado conducts the Filarmonica Arturo Toscanini, the Coro del Teatro Regio di Parma, and four vocal soloists in an outstanding performance of Giuseppe Verdi's Messa da Requiem, recorded at the Parco Ducale di Parma, Italy as part of Festival Verdi 2020. The soloists are soprano Eleonora Buratto, mezzosoprano Anita Rachvelishvili, tenor Giorgio Berrugi, and bass Roberto Tagliavini. When his fellow composer Gioachino Rossini died in 1868, Verdi proposed to compose a ‘Messa per Rossini' in his honor, to be written by himself and several other Italian composers. Verdi wrote the concluding movement, ‘Libera me'. When the premiere was cancelled, the project lay dormant. When Italian poet Alessandro Manzoni passed away a few years later, Verdi revisited his plan to compose a requiem – this time in honor of the poet he so greatly admired. As an opera composer, Verdi knew better than anyone how to infuse the work with drama, as is evident in the revised version of his ‘Libera me'. The famous, powerful ‘Dies Irae' especially stands out, depicting the horrors of the Last Judgement.

programme.title: Gilberto Gil
programme.desc: Brazilian artist Gilberto Gil returns to Jazz à Vienne in France with a new round of singing that is inspired by his latest album ‘Fé na Festa': a mixture of celebration, tradition and even some rock now and then. Gilberto Gil, worldwide known for as musician and the Brazilian minister of Culture, was one of the pioneers of the cultural movement ‘tropicalismo'. This movement, with a strong character of social protest, combines elements of traditional Brazilian culture with modern art forms. Gilberto Gil's new sound clearly has its roots in Brazilian culture, yet it is always inspired by jazz.

programme.title: Paul Desmond
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Chucho Valdés
programme.desc: Legendary Cuban pianist Chucho Valdés brought his band ‘Jazz Batá 2' to the Malta Jazz Festival on July 19, 2019. The air was thick with anticipation as Valdés took to the stage, revisiting the small-group concept of his mythical 1972 Cuban album ‘Jazz Batá'. The batá repertoire – the deep classical music of West Africa – permeates Valdés' piano solos throughout the concert. Valdés's band consists of Dreiser Durruthy (Batas and vocals), Yaroldy Abreu (percussions and vocals), Abraham Mansfarroll (percussion), Ramón Vazquez Martirena-Bajo (bass guitar). They delivered a performance that reverberated through the historic island.

programme.title: Ray Charles & The Raelettes
programme.sub-title: Ray Charles and the Raelettes - North Sea Jazz
programme.desc: The North Sea Jazz Festival is the largest indoor music festival in the world, known globally as the event where the past, present and future of jazz are featured within three days. Next to a firm base of jazz as the festival's staple music genre, many others, such as blues, soul, funk, or hip hop, pass by. In 1980, American soul legend Ray Charles brought the Raelettes and the Ray Charles Orchestra to the North Sea Jazz Festival in The Hague. With the full force of these two groups behind him, Charles showed why throughout his storied career he has been viewed as one of the most recognizable voices in music.

programme.title: Elizabeth Shepherd
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Roy Ayers
programme.desc: ‘The legend of the groove' is a series of documentaries devoted to the musicians who were most influential on contemporary hip hop, soul, rhythm 'n' blues, and on the course of history. Between the late 1950s and now, these musicians radically changed music. Although sometimes hardly in the public eye, they have all been major sources of inspiration for today's major artists: Prince, Erykah Badu, Janis Joplin and Jimi Hendrix.

programme.title: Christian McBride
programme.desc: On July 20, 2018, double bassist Christian McBride presented his band ‘New Jawn' at the Malta Jazz Festival. A five-time Grammy winner, McBride is one of the most requested, most recorded, and most respected figures in the music world today. Hailing from Philadelphia, this music luminary combines jazz, R&B, pop/rock, hip hop/neo-soul, and classical. Gracing the Malta Jazz stage with him are Nasheet Waits (drums), Marcus Strickland (tenor sax), and Josh Evans (trumpet).

programme.title: Keith Jarrett
programme.desc: Lugano Estival Jazz is an annual open-air music festival that takes place over five days at the picturesque city of Lugano, Switzerland. Since 1979, this musical Mecca has been a must-attend event for all jazz and world music fans worldwide. On July 3, 1986, American pianist and composer Keith Jarrett is joined by bassist Gary Peacock and drummer Jack DeJohnette at Estival Jazz Lugano. Known as the Standards Trio, they put on an enthralling performance that shows these master musicians at their best.

programme.title: Christian McBride
programme.sub-title: Josh Evans - Ballad Of Ernie Washington
programme.desc: On July 20, 2018, double bassist Christian McBride presented his band ‘New Jawn' at the Malta Jazz Festival. A five-time Grammy winner, McBride is one of the most requested, most recorded, and most respected figures in the music world today. Hailing from Philadelphia, this music luminary combines jazz, R&B, pop/rock, hip hop/neo-soul, and classical. Gracing the Malta Jazz stage with him are Nasheet Waits (drums), Marcus Strickland (tenor sax), and Josh Evans (trumpet).

programme.title: Billie Holiday
programme.desc: “God Bless The Child”, “Foolin' Myself”, and “I Loves You, Porgy”: timeless songs that were made classics by the inimitable Billie Holiday. ‘Lady Day', as her loyal friend and musical partner Lester Young nicknamed her, was a highly original jazz and pop singer. In a career that spanned most of the 1930s, 1940s and 1950s, she displayed an uncanny ability to convey emotion through her voice. Her vocals, which were strongly inspired by instrumental jazz, are admired for their deeply personal and intimate sound. This compilation features recordings from the 1950s of Billie Holiday singing a string of her greatest successes. Enjoy this unique footage of one of jazz's all-time greats!

programme.title: Coleman Hawkins
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Coleman Hawkins
programme.desc: A jazz festival named after the inventor of the instrument most associated with the genre, Adolphe Sax, would be incomplete without the man who laid the groundwork for how the instrument is played today. This must have been the reasoning of the organizers of the Festival International de Jazz Adolphe Sax in Dinant, Belgium, when they invited tenor saxophone giant Coleman Hawkins to perform there in June 1962. Appearing with a group that includes the French pianist George Arvanitas, one-time Duke Ellington bassist Jimmy Woode, and expat drummer Kansas Fields, the musician also known as ‘Bean' and ‘Hawk' serves up an hour-long set of familiar standards bookended by Hank Jones' “Chant” and J. J. Johnson's “Wee Dot”.

programme.title: Frans Welser-Möst, Cleveland Orchestra and Chorus, Siobhan Stagg & Avery Amereau
programme.desc: Franz Welser-Möst conducts the Cleveland Orchestra and Chorus in a concert performing Richard Strauss' Metamorphosen (A Study for 23 Solo Strings) and Mozart's Requiem, K. 626. Soloists are Siobhan Stagg (soprano), Avery Amereau (contralto), Ben Bliss (tenor) and Anthony Robin Schneider (bass). Recorded at Severance Hall, Cleveland in March 2023.

programme.title: Jos van Immerseel, Anima Eterna Brugge, Claron McFadden & Bart Van Caenegem
programme.desc: Belgian conductor Jos van Immerseel leads Anima Eterna Brugge in a concert program dedicated to American composer George Gershwin. The program opens with Gershwin's symphonic suite Catfish Row (arr. Steven D. Bowen) which is based upon music from his famous opera Porgy and Bess (1935). This is followed by the well-known tone poem An American in Paris (1928). After, soprano Claron McFadden joins the orchestra, presenting a selection of Gershwin's classic jazz songs, including ‘The man I love' (1924-27), ‘I got rhythm' (1930), and ‘By Strauss' (1936). She also performs ‘My man's gone now' and ‘Summertime' from Porgy and Bess. The concert ends with Gershwin's celebrated Rhapsody in Blue, with Bart Van Caenegem as featured pianist. This performance was recorded at Concertgebouw Brugge, Belgium, on March 3, 2017.

programme.title: Sir Simon Rattle & London Symphony Orchestra
programme.sub-title: Beethoven - Symphony No. 5 in C minor, Op. 67
programme.desc: Sir Simon Rattle conducts the London Symphony Orchestra (LSO) in a performance of Ludwig van Beethoven's well-known Symphony No. 5 in C minor, Op. 67. With Sir Simon Rattle's mischievous enthusiasm, this famous heavyweight symphony sounds new again. This performance was recorded at LSO St. Luke's in London, UK, on September 23, 2020.

programme.title: Roberto Abbado, Filarmonica Arturo Toscanini, Coro del Teatro Regio di Parma & Eleonora Buratto
programme.desc: Roberto Abbado conducts the Filarmonica Arturo Toscanini, the Coro del Teatro Regio di Parma, and four vocal soloists in an outstanding performance of Giuseppe Verdi's Messa da Requiem, recorded at the Parco Ducale di Parma, Italy as part of Festival Verdi 2020. The soloists are soprano Eleonora Buratto, mezzosoprano Anita Rachvelishvili, tenor Giorgio Berrugi, and bass Roberto Tagliavini. When his fellow composer Gioachino Rossini died in 1868, Verdi proposed to compose a ‘Messa per Rossini' in his honor, to be written by himself and several other Italian composers. Verdi wrote the concluding movement, ‘Libera me'. When the premiere was cancelled, the project lay dormant. When Italian poet Alessandro Manzoni passed away a few years later, Verdi revisited his plan to compose a requiem – this time in honor of the poet he so greatly admired. As an opera composer, Verdi knew better than anyone how to infuse the work with drama, as is evident in the revised version of his ‘Libera me'. The famous, powerful ‘Dies Irae' especially stands out, depicting the horrors of the Last Judgement.

Desencantado con su rutina diaria, Max tropieza con una reliquia familiar que le permite ser testigo de la vida de sus clientes a través de los zapatos que repara y ver el mundo de una forma nueva.

programme.title: El escritor
programme.desc: Oso de Plata al Mejor Director en el Festival de Berlín 2010. Roman Polanski dirige un apasionado thriller político cargado de suspense en un mundo en el que nada es lo que parece.

programme.title: Deseando amar
programme.desc: Dos vecinos forman un fuerte vínculo después de que ambos sospechen de actividades extramatrimoniales de sus cónyuges. Sin embargo, acuerdan mantener su vínculo platónico para no cometer errores similares.

programme.title: La huella del silencio
programme.desc: Una niña de once años de edad de una familia disfuncional demuestra una notable, casi mística, don para deletrear cuando gana concursos de ortografía del distrito y se califica para los nacionales de repente, se convierte en el centro de atención y se gana la aprobación de su padre.

programme.title: Z. La ciudad perdida
programme.desc: Prodigio narrativo de una épica abrumadora y un sentido de la aventura vibrante y expeditivo que se erige como una expecional muestra de cine clásico contemporáneo. A principios del s.XX un explorador británico se obesiona con encontrar una antigua civilización avanzada en la selva del Amazonas.

programme.title: Trust
programme.desc: Will Cameron y Lynn han criado a tres hijos despiertos e inteligentes, y todos tenían la sensación de que, una vez las puertas estaban cerradas y la alarma puesta, nada podía pasarles. Pero Annie, su hija de 14 años, empieza una relación on-line con un chicoy rápidamente se gana su confianza

programme.title: Tucker: The Man and His Dream
programme.desc: Un diseñador de coches se enfrenta a toda la industria automovilística con sus revolucionarios diseños.

programme.title: Palm Swings
programme.desc: Tras mudarse a Palm Springs, un matrimonio pone a prueba su amor al descubrir que sus vecinos son swingers.

programme.title: La Ola Perfecta
programme.desc: ¿Podrías encontrar a tu amor verdadero haciendo surf?

programme.title: Para Toda la Vida
programme.desc: Una madre lucha por cuidar a su bebé mientras el padre se aleja de ellos.

programme.title: El Puente de San Luis Rey
programme.desc: Cuando el puente de San Luis se derrumba, los viajeros caen al abismo.

programme.title: New York, I Love You
programme.desc: Siguiendo los pasos del éxito de “Paris, je t'aime” (2006), doce directores y varios actores de primera línea toman la ciudad de Nueva York como plató y narran diferentes historias de amor en esta película coral que muestra la pasión que puede despertar esa gran ciudad.

programme.title: Lío en Broadway
programme.desc: Durante los ensayos de un nuevo proyecto teatral se forma un triángulo amoroso entre una esposa, una ex-amante, y una de las actrices.

programme.title: Algo prestado
programme.desc: La vida de Rachel se complica cuando acaba celebrando su treinta cumpleaños acostándose con el prometido de su mejor amiga. Divertida comedia romántica protagonizada por Kate Hudson

programme.title: Love's Kitchen
programme.desc: Rob es un reconocido chef de Londres, su carrera es un éxito y la vida le sonríe hasta que un accidente acaba con la vida de su esposa. Superado por la tristeza, Rob pierde su restaurante y su interés por la cocina, hasta que animado por un grupo de amigos y su hija, decide empezar de nuevo.

programme.title: Love bite
programme.desc: La escuela ha terminado y el verano empieza en la ciudad costera de Rainmouth. Jamie, un chico de 18 años, deberá empezar a trabajar en el negocio familiar junto a su madre. Aburrido y agobiado, Jamie fantasea con escapar de allí hasta que de repente aparece en el pueblo Juliana, una guapa, inteligente y sexy viajante americana de la que se enamora inmediatamente. Pero hay un recién llegado más siniestro en la ciudad: un hombre lobo se alimenta de vírgenes, y Rainmouth se convierte en un coto de caza.

programme.title: Más allá de la muerte
programme.desc: Tras un horrible accidente de tráfico, la joven Anna, a la que dan por muerta, despierta y se encuentra a Eliot Deacon, el director de la funeraria, preparándola para ser enterrada. Confusa y aterrorizada, Anna descubre que Eliot puede comunicarse con los difuntos. Atrapada en la funeraria y condenada a aceptar su propia muerte, intentará escapar de semejante pesadilla con la ayuda de su novio Paul.

programme.title: Recursos humanos
programme.desc: A un joven universitario lo contratan como pasante en el departamento de Recursos Humanos de una fábrica situada en la campiña francesa. Lleno de ilusión e ingenuidad, está convencido de que sus esfuerzos servirán para que los sindicatos y la dirección alcancen un acuerdo sobre la jornada laboral. Sin embargo, pronto se da cuenta de que su trabajo está, en realidad, al servicio de una reorganización de la empresa, que implica una reducción de la plantilla.

programme.title: Sweet Virginia
programme.desc: Un antiguo campeón de rodeo que arrastra un oscuro pasado regenta ahora un motel sencillo en un pequeño pueblo de Alaska. Uno de sus nuevos clientes es un implacable asesino a sueldo que acaba de cumplir un trabajo matando a tres personas en un bar. Pero su encargo solo contemplaba la muerte de uno de ellos, el marido de la mujer que le contrató.

programme.title: Trinidad y Bambino... (Tal Para Cual)
programme.desc: Trinidad descubre que Bambino fue condenado injustamente y huye con él para buscar a los culpables.

programme.title: Sharknado 4: Que La 4 Te Acompañe
programme.desc: Un extraño Sharknado de arena golpea Las Vegas, Fin vuelve a la acción y lucha contra el Sharknado.

programme.title: El Embajador de la India
programme.desc: Jaime Flórez¸ provinciano astuto y malicioso¸ se ve envuelto en el equívoco en una ciudad colombiana.

programme.title: El Forastero
programme.desc: El forastero procede de un planeta arrasado por el desorden medioambiental y la lluvia radiactiva.

programme.title: Igelak
programme.desc: Pello decide huir y cambiar de identidad, pero acaba viviendo en un edificio okupa.

programme.title: Frances Ha
programme.desc: Frances vive en Nueva York, aunque no tiene un apartamento. Es aprendiz en una compañía de danza, aunque no es realmente bailarina. Tiene una mejor amiga llamada Sophie, pero ahora mismo no se hablan. Frances quiere mucho más de lo que tiene, pero disfruta de la vida con alegría y despreocupación.

programme.title: Friday
programme.desc: La noche del viernes es casi como una noche de Año Nuevo acortada. Uno puede esperar todo tipo de sorpresas esa noche. La noche del viernes tiene su magia especial.

programme.title: Memorias de un hombre invisible
programme.desc: Un experimento del Gobierno fracasa y vuelve invisible a un testigo casual.

programme.title: Más vale sola que mal acompañada
programme.desc: Tras abandonar a su marido, una mujer recorre los Estados Unidos con sus dos hijos buscando desesperadamente un hombre capaz de mantenerlos económicamente. Basada en las memorias del actor George Hamilton.

programme.title: Atraco por duplicado
programme.desc: Tripp Kennedy entra tranquilamente en una sucursal bancaria poco antes de la hora de cierre, justo en el momento en que dos bandas distintas convergen por casualidad con intención de realizar un atraco. Todos ellos quedan atrapados en el edificio durante una noche que promete acción y diversión...

programme.title: Ishtar
programme.desc: Rogers y Clarke (Warren Beatty y Dustin Hoffman) son dos ineptos compositores sin suerte y desesperados por dinero. El dúo acepta el consejo de su sospechoso agente, y en un abrir y cerrar de ojos está en un recorrido por la mística república de Ishtar. A su llegada, nuestros héroes son reclutados por separado como espías de los bandos contrarios de una revolución planeada, y al mismo tiempo se disputan la atención de una hermosa revolucionaria (Isabelle Adjani). Sin embargo, Clarke y Rogers son peores espías que compositores, y en poco tiempo terminan varados en el desierto en compañía de un camello ciego y de varios asesinos de la CIA.

programme.title: Escuela De Genios
programme.desc: Tres brillantes universitarios trabajan en un proyecto de laboratorio pero tienen tiempo para divertirse y convertir la residencia en una pista de patinaje sobre hielo, desmontar y montar el coche de un compañero u organizar una fiesta playera en pleno auditórium. Cuando el trío descubre que el profesor Hathaway les ha tenido trabajando en un arma secreta para el ejército, deciden tramar un plan de venganza que dejará boquiabiertos a los militares.

programme.title: Papa Canguro 2
programme.desc: Charlie Hinton (Cuba Gooding Jr.) y Phil Ryerson (Paul Rae) asumen la dirección de un campamento de verano. Su desconocimiento de los grandes espacios abiertos, unas instalaciones destrozadas y un variopinto grupo de campistas hacen que muy pronto la situación se les vaya de las manos. Frente a las amenazas de cierre y el descenso de inscripciones, Charlie llama a su padre, de quien está distanciado, para que le ayude a organizar el campamento y a enseñar a todo el mundo a trabajar en equipo con perseverancia y flexibilidad.

programme.title: El Romance De Murphy
programme.desc: Lo último que Emma Moriarty (Sally Field) esperaba encontrar en Eunice, Arizona, era el amor. Pero cuando ella y su hijo (Corey Haim) se mudan a la ciudad, repentinamente descubre que es objeto de las atenciones de Murphy Jones (Garner) .

programme.title: Recopilación Bonanza Episodios 19, 20, 22
programme.desc: Las aventuras del Salvaje Oeste de Ben Cartwright y sus hijos mientras dirigen y defienden su rancho de Nevada al tiempo que ayudan a la comunidad de los alrededores.

programme.title: Cinco pistolas
programme.desc: Shalee Jethro (Dorothy Malone) ayuda a su padre a dirigir una estación de diligencias en el desierto.

programme.title: Frontera de tormentas
programme.desc: Tras escapar de la banda de los Silers, Winnetou y su hermana llegan a Miramonte junto a Old Firehand. Mientras la banda prepara un ataque para liberar a uno de los suyos, Old Firehand descubre un importante secreto familiar. Unidos, deberán organizar la defensa del pueblo frente a la inminente amenaza.

programme.title: Union Bound
programme.desc: El sargento Joseph Hoover lucha por la Unión, pero tras ser capturado y enviado a un campo de prisioneros, comprende el verdadero significado del cautiverio. Con la ayuda de un amigo y unos esclavos, logra escapar y emprende un arriesgado camino hacia la libertad.

programme.title: Diallelos
programme.desc: Dos estafadores locales se proponen jugar con una ingenua empresaria japonesa, robarle una gran suma de dinero y además cobrar venganza. Pero no todo sale como lo planeado cuando la mujer no es tan inocente como se imaginan y además uno de ellos se enamora.

programme.title: Un Año y algo más
programme.desc: Un reparto de lujo encabeza esta historia aclamada por la crítica sobre un joven que, tras caerse de un tejado en una fiesta de Año Nuevo, decide que es hora de hacer algunos cambios en su vida, como reencontrarse con su hijo y enamorarse.

programme.title: Whale Rider
programme.desc: Una historia contemporánea de amor, rechazo y triunfo que narra la lucha de una joven maorí por alcanzar un destino que su abuelo se niega a reconocer.

programme.title: Lizzie
programme.desc: Una niña rebelde es enviada a pasar La Navidad al rancho de caballos de su abuela. Entabla amistad con el poni de su abuela y está decidida a ayudar a salvar el rancho de la ejecución hipotecaria.

programme.title: Bienvenido a casa
programme.desc: Aún de luto por la muerte de su esposa, Bruno está irremediablemente apegado a la cabaña junto al mar que construyeron juntos. Cuando es desalojado por sus desalmados suegros, Bruno promete recuperarlo a cualquier precio.

programme.title: Jake
programme.desc: Una pareja casada, Alex y Greg, tiene que afrontar un conflicto cuando descubre que su hijo prefiere a la Cenicienta en lugar de los G.I. Joe.

programme.title: Red Dog
programme.desc: Adaptación de la novela Louis De Bernieres basada en un hecho real, narra como un perro kelpie australiano se une a una comunidad minera durante los años setenta.

programme.title: Momo: Una aventura contrarreloj
programme.desc: Momo es una niña tímida y cariñosa que ha encontrado nuevos amigos y una casa en medio de las ruinas de un antiguo anfiteatro. Pero un día, repentinamente, los Hombres Grises irrumpen en la ciudad, con el objetivo de robar el tiempo a la gente. Momo desearía impedírselo, pero no sabe como… Casiopea, una pequeña tortuga mágica, la lleva a conocer al Maestro Hora, el Administrador del tiempo. Él es la única persona que puede ayudarla. Cuando regresa para luchar contra los Hombres Grises, se da cuenta de que ya no hay nadie con quien hablar o jugar y teme haber perdido para siempre a sus amigos. El mundo ha cambiado y todos han sido englobados en una nueva y rígida estructura social… A pesar de su repentina soledad, está decidida a intentar lo imposible para salvar a sus amigos y a la ciudad entera.

programme.title: Mañana, cuando la guerra empiece
programme.desc: Cuando su país es invadido y sus familias secuestradas, ocho adolescentes se unen para luchar.

programme.title: ärtico
programme.desc: Dos jóvenes “quinquis” salen cada día despreocupadamente a la calle para buscarse la vida con lo que les salga. Pero además de sus cotidianos robos y trapicheos, algo les revuelve en su interior.

programme.title: Amateurs
programme.desc: Marsella (Francia): El día que Blanca cumple 16 años, su madre muere sepultada bajo tres toneladas de pescado, quedando sola en la vida. Vallecas (Madrid): Julio Nieves, un fornido capataz de la construcción de 65 años, cae desplomado en su ducha. A partir de ahora se enfrenta a su dura jubilación.

programme.title: Frontera
programme.desc: Un grupo de teatro ensaya una versión de 12 hombres sin piedad cuando los interrumpe una alarma. Nos encontramos dentro de la prisión de Quatre Camins y la señal indica el aislamiento de los módulo.

programme.title: Un largo viaje (2023)
programme.desc: Una vieja autocaravana será el nuevo hogar de Violeta y Samuel con vistas a un complejo comercial del sur de Madrid, donde tratarán de reconciliarse y hacer frente a la vida con tan solo veintidós euros en el bolsillo y “mucha imaginación”.

programme.title: La espina de Dios
programme.desc: Un pequeño grupo de hombres comienza a predicar la próxima venida del Reino. Su líder, el rabí Jesús de Nazaret insufla ilusión en los corazones, su mensaje es de amor y esperanza, aunque no todos supieron comprenderlo.

programme.title: Carnival of Souls
programme.desc: After a traumatic accident, a woman becomes drawn to a mysterious abandoned carnival.

programme.title: The Man Who Could Work Miracles
programme.desc: Roland Young stars in H.G. Wells' light-hearted comedy about what happens when some bored celestials decide to give "an ordinary little fellow" the power to work miracles - just to see what he will do with it. George, a draper's assistant, is suddenly endowed with the power to work miracles, but when he still can't win the love of Ada, he slowly begins to realize that he has omnipotence over everything except the human mind.

programme.title: 2 Palomas
programme.desc: Un agente inmobiliario amoral y grasiento es presa de una de sus victimas, que se muda silenciosamente a su apartamento y, sin ser visto, comienza una deliciosa y maliciosa campana de venganza. Two Pigeons es una comedia negra con una vena siniestra.

programme.title: Chain Letter
programme.desc: Six friends receive a mysterious chain letter via text and email from a maniac who hunts down those who delete the message. Who knew they should take the threats in the chain letter seriously or that their favorite technologies could help track and kill them? This maniacal game pits friend against friend as they try to escape the impossible. Break the chain, lose a life.

programme.title: Deadly Virtues: Love.Honour.Obey
programme.desc: A stranger breaks into the house of a couple, ties up the husband and, having a whole weekend at his hand, plays a slow game with the woman, a game of threats, fear, obedience - and intimacy.

programme.title: 2 Palomas
programme.desc: Un agente inmobiliario amoral y grasiento es presa de una de sus victimas, que se muda silenciosamente a su apartamento y, sin ser visto, comienza una deliciosa y maliciosa campana de venganza. Two Pigeons es una comedia negra con una vena siniestra.

programme.title: Chain Letter
programme.desc: Six friends receive a mysterious chain letter via text and email from a maniac who hunts down those who delete the message. Who knew they should take the threats in the chain letter seriously or that their favorite technologies could help track and kill them? programme.title: Scared to Death
programme.desc: From a slab in the morgue, a dead young woman tells the bizarre tale of how she got there, through a maze of murder involving a hypnotist, a midget and a mysterious figure in a green mask.

programme.title: Avalanche Sharks
programme.desc: Es vacaciones de primavera en una estación de esquí de Estados Unidos. Los visitantes y el personal del resort son atacados por tiburones de nieve, invocados en la montaña hace mucho tiempo por chamanes indígenas americanos en busca de venganza.

programme.title: Indomable
programme.desc: Estilizado y contundente thriller de acción de Steven Soderbergh. La hermosa Mallory Kane es una joven soldado contratada por numerosos gobiernos para realizar tareas que ellos mismos no podrían llevar a cabo... Se le encomienda una misión donde es traicionada. Ahora sólo planea su venganza.

programme.title: Juntos para vencer
programme.desc: Un adolescente acosado que sueña con ser el compañero de Chuck Norris se entrena en artes marciales para hacer realidad sus sueños.

programme.title: Una amenaza en la sombra
programme.desc: Wes Rawlins es un cazarecompensas y hombre de pocas palabras. Queda devastado cuando su madre es asesinada por una pareja de forajidos.

programme.title: Juego Mortal
programme.desc: Nueve amigos despiertan con bombas en el pecho y descubren que pueden transferirse el tiempo entre ellos.

programme.title: Sin escapatoria
programme.desc: Shannon presencia un asesinato y huye de policías corruptos. Jack, un exagente, la ayuda a sobrevivir.

programme.title: Twist
programme.desc: Un joven grafitero se une a una banda para dar el golpe del siglo entre traiciones y persecuciones.

programme.title: Bigfoot
programme.desc: Bigfoot ataca un concierto de música.

programme.title: Asesinos Anónimos
programme.desc: En un grupo de apoyo para asesinos, la confianza es importante, pero un misterio creará fuertes tensiones.

programme.title: Kung Fu Sion
programme.desc: La historia se sitúa durante el caos pre-revolucionario de los años 40 en China. Sing (Stephen Chow) es un delincuente con poca suerte decidido a entrar en el Axe Gang, uno de los clanes mafiosos más importantes de China. Para lograrlo, Sing pretende sacar dinero de los vecinos de un bloque de casas, pero pronto descubre que éstos no son lo que parecen. La banda Axe Gang acude a la zona y una serie de sucesos lleva hasta la confrontación final entre los vecinos y los delincuentes.

programme.title: Mandíbulas
programme.desc: Bienvenido al Lago Negro. Este tranquilo paraje es el último lugar en el que uno esperaría encontrar un reptil de 9 metros de la especie Crocodylus, más conocida como cocodrilo. Es en este lago donde una paleontóloga neoyorquina con fobia a la naturaleza, que ha sido enviada a regañadientes para su primera misión de campo real, se une a un excéntrico multimillonario para encontrar esta amenaza.

programme.title: El Sicario de Dios
programme.desc: En un mundo post-apocalíptico, una guerra encarnizada entre hombres y vampiros se ha prolongado durante siglos. Un sacerdote renegado luchará por salvar a su sobrina de la garras de los vampiros que desean convertirla en una de ellos. Para salvarla, este sacerdote guerrero tendrá que romper su juramento de paz, y darle caza al enjambre antes de que sea demasiado tarde.
